subject: Montclair Systems — VPC decode errors and throughput surge / exec sync requested
messages:
From: Allison Reeve <allison.reeve@montclairsys.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Diego Ruiz <diego.ruiz@montclairsys.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Severe latency + decode errors on our VPC cluster — urgent

Hi Priyom,

We started seeing a sudden jump in inference latency and a burst of decode-related 5xx errors on our private VPC deployment this morning (~06:45 UTC). Throughput spiked at the same time — requests per second shot up ~3x compared to baseline and p95 moved from ~220ms to ~1.2s. A subset of requests are returning "decoder overflow" style errors (see attached kvcache_dump_1115.log snippet).

This is impacting our checkout microservice (cart-check) and causing retries in our service mesh. Diego and I pulled logs and a small trace bundle — attaching montclair_logs_1115.zip and a p95 plot. Can someone from Redwood operationally triage?

We need:
- Immediate mitigation suggestions we can apply without a deploy (routing, model fallback, throttling)
- A plan and timeline for a deeper kernel/kv-cache tweak if required
- Executive visibility — this is customer-facing revenue traffic.

Thanks,
Allison
Account Executive, Montclair Systems
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Allison Reeve <allison.reeve@montclairsys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T09:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Severe latency + decode errors on our VPC cluster — urgent

Allison — thanks for the quick alert and the attachments. We're on it.

Immediate steps (we're executing now):
1) Enabling request-level routing to a lower-latency model variant for cart-check to reduce p95 and limit retries.
2) Temporarily lowering concurrency per worker on the affected pool to reduce KV cache contention.
3) Enabling an emergency 10% traffic shed to fallback region if errors exceed threshold.

Internal owners (cc'd) — please pick up investigation in parallel:
- Dev: collect kernel metrics + examine kv cache eviction pattern from the bundle Allison sent.
- Marissa: run quick cost/credits ask prep and liaise with Customer Success for exec communication.
- Rishi/Evelyn: prepare an exec summary and propose a 30-min sync window.

Allison — we'll update within 45 minutes with status and short-term mitigations applied.

- Priyom
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Allison Reeve <allison.reeve@montclairsys.com>, Diego Ruiz <diego.ruiz@montclairsys.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T10:25:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: initial triage notes — KV hotspot + decode path saturation

Quick findings from logs/trace bundle:
- KV cache hit-rate for the cart-check model dropped from ~88% to ~43% during the spike window (06:40–07:10 UTC). The cache eviction churn increased sharply — suggests working set exceeded configured KV capacity for that pool.
- Concurrent decode goroutines saturated a single CPU-affine kernel on the node family in question; we see queue length spikes ahead of the 5xx bursts.
- A small percentage (~6%) of requests are hitting a previously-unencountered tokenization corner-case leading to decoder errors; these appear correlated with longer input sequences (customer-provided dev tokens).

Short-term mitigation applied (as Priyom described): routed 18% of cart-check traffic to the smaller-latency variant; reduced worker concurrency to 12 on the affected pool; enabled aggressive prefix caching for repeated request prefixes. Initial effect: p95 back to ~380ms and 5xx rate down 70%.

Next steps I recommend:
- Increase KV cache allocation for this customer pool by +30% (requires node-level config change and can be rolled back).
- Patch decode tokenization path to guard the corner-case (will need a hotfix build; estimate 2 business days for QA + rollout).
- Post-mortem and regression test set for their prompt distribution.

I've uploaded the kernel metrics and a short replay script to the shared doc (link in related_links). Attaching kvcache_dump_1115.log snippet for ops reference.

- Dev
Senior Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Allison Reeve <allison.reeve@montclairsys.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T12:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Internal: initial triage notes — KV hotspot + decode path saturation

Thanks Dev — that aligns with what I was expecting. For exec visibility: Marissa, Priyom — can you prepare a one-page exec brief with impact (revenue risk, affected services, SLA exposure), and propose a customer-facing remediation timeline? Allison — would you be able to join a 30-min exec sync today between 16:00–17:30 PT or tomorrow morning? We want Product/R&D and Customer Success on the call.

Also: Marissa, please draft a short credit/commitment proposal — given the outage duration and retries, Montclair will likely request a goodwill credit and a commitment timeline for the hotfix.

I'll standby for the brief and the preferred sync time.

- Rishi
VP, Product Operations
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Allison Reeve <allison.reeve@montclairsys.com>, Diego Ruiz <diego.ruiz@montclairsys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-17T16:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Severe latency + decode errors on our VPC cluster — exec sync scheduled + next steps

Allison / Diego — thanks again for your patience. Quick update and next actions: 

1) Short-term: the mitigations deployed on 11/15 stabilized traffic. Since then p95 has stayed ~350–420ms and 5xxs are under 0.15% for cart-check.
2) Mid-term plan: we will increase KV allocation for your dedicated pool on Wednesday 2026-11-18 at 02:00 PT (low-traffic window). This is a non-disruptive config change but we'll monitor closely.
3) Patch timeline: dev to deliver tokenization guard hotfix by 2026-11-19 EOD PST; QA and controlled rollout completed by 2026-11-22.
4) Exec sync: scheduled for 2026-11-17T17:30:00-08:00 (30 min). Attendees: Montclair ENG/Prod leads + Redwood Product Ops, Serving Runtime, Customer Success. Dial-in and materials: https://redwood-console.example.com/dashboards/MONT-7821/perf

Marissa has prepared a goodwill credit proposal (attached as a stub in the exec doc). We'll share the post-mortem within 72 hours of the patch rollout.

If anything changes before the sync, I'll update the thread.

Best,
Priyom
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
